title: Automations
intro: Missions on a schedule, context rules and webhooks, in one list. Each one starts the moment you switch it on. There is no save button: text saves when you leave the field, switches save at once.
heldBanner: Webhook deliveries waiting for your yes: {{n}}

new.scheduleBlurb: A mission sent on chosen days at a time, or on a repeat
new.contextBlurb: Text every agent reads before it starts
new.webhookBlurb: Outside events in, held for your yes if you like

all.title: Nothing automated yet
all.body: Pick what to set up first. It starts switched off, so you can write it before it runs.

schedule.title: No schedules
schedule.body: A schedule sends a mission on chosen weekdays at a time, or on a repeat: a morning triage at 9, a Friday summary at 5.

context.title: No context rules
context.body: A context rule is text every agent reads before it starts, like your house style.

webhook.title: No webhooks
webhook.body: A webhook brings outside events in: an issue labelled bug, a failed deploy, a form someone sent.

field.name: Name
field.required: This cannot be empty, so the saved value was kept.
field.tooLong: Too long: keep it under {{max}} characters. The saved text was kept.

blocked.noPrompt: Write the mission first, then switch it on.
blocked.noWhen: Pick when it runs first, then switch it on.
blocked.noTarget: Pick who it goes to first, then switch it on.
blocked.noRuleText: Write the rule first, then switch it on.

desc.heartbeat: {{when}}, a look at the floor; {{godName}} is nudged only when it has gone quiet
desc.rule: A context rule every agent reads: {{what}}
desc.ruleEmpty: A context rule, not written yet
desc.compact: {{every}} at most, compacts any agent past {{pct}}% of its context
desc.clear: {{every}} at most, clears any agent past {{pct}}% of its context

webhook.holdAll: A webhook: everything waits for your yes, then goes to {{godName}}
webhook.passAll: A webhook: everything goes straight to {{godName}}
webhook.holdWork: A webhook: questions go straight in, work waits for your yes

when.badCount: Use a whole number from 1 to {{max}}.
when.pickADay: Pick at least one day. Nothing is saved until you do.
when.localTime: Times are this computer's local time.

schedule.promptPlaceholder: Sort the new GitHub issues into tickets and tell me what looks urgent.
schedule.promptHint: Sent to {{target}} as a request every time it runs.
schedule.heartbeatHint: The heartbeat looks at the floor on this cadence and nudges {{godName}} only when everyone has gone quiet. This text is the nudge.

rule.textPlaceholder: Write in plain English. No exclamation marks. Sentence case for headings.
rule.hint: Every agent reads this before it starts, and running agents pick up a change on their next prompt. Agents whose engine has no hook support do not see context rules.

compact.name: Auto-compact
compact.blurb: Asks an agent to summarise its context and carry on once it fills past the bar. Nothing is lost; the context gets shorter.
compact.messageHint: Added to the compaction command on engines that read it.

clear.name: Auto-clear
clear.blurb: Throws an agent's context away once it fills past the bar. For agents whose work needs no memory between tasks.
clear.messageHint: Leave empty to send the engine's own clear command; set one for engines that have none.
clear.caution: Clearing discards the conversation. It ships switched off; turn it on only for agents that can start fresh.

maintenance.barHint: 0 means time alone sets it off.
maintenance.bigBarHint: A lower bar for windows of about a million tokens, where a smaller share is still a lot of text.

modeHint.strict: Every delivery waits for your yes.
modeHint.allow-all: Messages and requests for work go straight to {{godName}}.
modeHint.communication-only: Questions and updates go straight in; requests for work wait for your yes.

webhook.addressWhenOn: Switch it on to get its public address.
webhook.howToCall: POST JSON with a "message" field, and send the secret in the x-md-webhook-secret header.
webhook.tunnelPending: The server is up; the public address is still being set up.
webhook.serverDown: The webhook server is not running. It starts when a webhook is on; check your connection if this stays.
webhook.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
webhook.secretHint: The caller sends this with every request. Anyone who has it can post to this webhook.
webhook.schemaHint: Deliveries are checked against this. "message" is the one field the floor needs.
webhook.badSchema: Not valid JSON, so it was not saved: {{error}}
webhook.kindDirective: Asks the floor to do something
webhook.noSecret: This webhook has no secret, so it cannot be switched on. Delete it and make a new one.

error.invalid: That did not pass the app's check, so nothing was saved.
error.full: That is as many context rules as the floor can hold. Delete one first.
error.writeFailed: Could not write the settings file. Check the disk and try again.
error.notDispatched: Not sent yet: the floor could not take it. Open a hive, then approve again.
error.loadFailed: Some automations could not be read: {{error}}
